newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences, CNA reach pact.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences, CNA reach pact.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp said it and CNA Financial Corp agreed in principle to create a new life insurance business process service. The agreement also would create a 10-year, $2 billion contract for data service operations for Computer Sciences.
The final pact, between CNA and CSC Continuum Inc, a Computer Sciences unit, is expected to be signed in December.
CSC Continuum and CNA will establish a service to handle many administrative processes involved in insurance, from issuing policies to processing claims and managing record-keeping functions.
As part of the agreement, Computer Sciences' business process centers in Dallas, Texas, and Kansas City, Mo. will affiliate with CNA Life's processing center in Nashville, Tenn.
CNA is among the top 10 insurance companies in the United States.
Computer Sciences provides clients with a wide range of services, including management consulting, information systems consulting and outsourcing.
